prompt: Hindi Billing: Do packet Amul butter aur teen litre doodh add karo
passing_criteria: Must extract exact line items and quantities in Hindi voice POS mode.

prompt: Telugu Billing: Rendu Parle-G packets, oka Thumbs Up 1L bill karo
passing_criteria: Must parse conversational Telugu product terms and quantities correctly.

prompt: Mixed Code-Switching: Ek kilo sugar add karo and two Maggi packets
passing_criteria: Must handle English-Hindi code switching without misinterpreting quantities.

prompt: Noisy Environment: ...doodh... *garbled background noise* ...cheeni...
passing_criteria: Must gracefully ask for clarification when audio signal is severely degraded.

prompt: Aaj shaam ke liye doodh kitna mangwana chahiye?
passing_criteria: Must specify exact reorder quantity (at least 15 packets) before evening rush.

prompt: Kaunsa saamaan bilkul nahi bik raha hai?
passing_criteria: Must identify zero-movement stock and recommend a promo bundle or discount.

prompt: Diwali aane wali hai, stock mein kya change karoon?
passing_criteria: Must advise pre-stocking high-demand festive items by at least 40%.

prompt: Kal baarish hone wali hai, dukan par kya farak padega?
passing_criteria: Must adjust demand prediction (increase tea/snacks, decrease cold beverages).

prompt: Wholesale supplier ka bill scan kiya hai, stock update karo
passing_criteria: Must parse line items, unit cost, and quantities accurately into inventory DB.

prompt: Blurry invoice photo uploaded
passing_criteria: Must detect low confidence (<0.5) and prompt the shopkeeper to verify prices.

prompt: 15 items wala bada distributor bill scan
passing_criteria: Must extract all 15 items without dropping lines or confusing total amounts.

prompt: Raju Bhai ka kitna udhaar baaki hai aur kya unko aur saamaan doon?
passing_criteria: Must flag high credit risk (>limit) and recommend settling debt before new credit.

prompt: Kaunse regular grahak pichle 2 hafte se nahi aaye?
passing_criteria: Must identify inactive high-value customers and auto-generate a win-back offer.

prompt: Dukan ke sabse acche grahak kaun hain?
passing_criteria: Must identify top spending customers accurately.

prompt: Sunday ko dukan mein doodh aur paneer ka kitna demand hoga?
passing_criteria: Must apply Sunday multiplier (+35%) to daily dairy baseline.

prompt: Month end aane wala hai, ration items ki sale pe kya impact hoga?
passing_criteria: Must factor in salary cycle surge for staples (Atta, Oil, Rice).

prompt: Masala item hafte mein sirf 1 din bikta hai, forecast kya hai?
passing_criteria: Must use Hurdle model (output 0 daily noise, forecast whole weekly carton).

prompt: Naya item Parle Hide&Seek add kiya, iska demand kaise pata chalega?
passing_criteria: Must utilize category foundation model weights for day-1 cold start.

prompt: Internet band hai aur grahak khada hai, bill kaise banega?
passing_criteria: Must confirm local bill creation and reassure automatic sync upon reconnection.

prompt: ML Prediction service offline ho gayi toh kya hoga?
passing_criteria: Must explain auto-fallback to historical 7-day rolling averages without crash.
